assessments.quote: This study evaluates the diagnostic performance of artificial intelligence models, including machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL), in predicting MVI in HCC using imaging modalities such as CT, MRI, ultrasound, PET/CT, and histopathology.
assessments.reason: Systematic review/meta-analysis of AI models predicting MVI in HCC, including MRI-based models with pooled AUCs. However, it pools multiple modalities (CT, MRI, US, PET/CT) rather than being MRI-specific, and covers studies 2010-2023, not strictly the last three years. Useful overview but violates the MRI-only and temporal constraints.

assessments.quote: This study aims to develop a framework integrating dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI)-based multi-channel deep learning combined with clinical modeling for the non-invasive preoperative discrimination between hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and mass-forming intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (MF-ICC).
assessments.reason: MRI deep learning in HCC but the endpoint is differentiating HCC from intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, not predicting microvascular invasion. Task/endpoint mismatch.

assessments.quote: We aimed to evaluate three-dimensional, multiscale, multimodel DWI parameters within intratumoral and peritumoral volumes of interest for predicting microvascular invasion (MVI) in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).
assessments.reason: Prospective MRI (diffusion) study predicting MVI in HCC with a combined model (AUROC 0.844) and SHAP interpretability. Matches population, task, modality, and recent timeframe. Reports methods and results; limitations only implicit.

assessments.quote: This study encoded feature variations across multi-phase MRI sequences for the preoperative prediction of MVI.
assessments.reason: Retrospective multiphase MRI radiomics study predicting MVI in small HCC (<=3 cm), best AUC 0.850. Matches population, prediction task, MRI modality, and recent timeframe. Provides methods and results.

assessments.quote: Here, we present OpenSwissHCC, a curated multiphasic dataset of 132 multiparametric DCE-MRI scans from adult patients with chronic liver disease
assessments.reason: Data paper describing an MRI dataset for HCC detection/segmentation/characterization. No MVI prediction task; endpoint mismatch.

assessments.quote: To investigate the clinical utility of fluorine-18-labeled fibroblast activation protein (FAP) inhibitor ([ 18 F]FAPI) positron emission tomography/computed tomography (PET/CT) relative to [ 18 F]fluorodeoxyglucose ([ 18 F]FDG) PET/CT for tumor detection and staging in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) patients.
assessments.reason: PET/CT study on HCC detection and staging, not MRI and not MVI prediction. Modality and task mismatch.

assessments.quote: A foundation model-enabled framework for pathology-informed VETC prediction on pretreatment magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), termed PIVOT
assessments.reason: MRI prediction in HCC but the endpoint is vessels encapsulating tumor clusters (VETC), not microvascular invasion. Endpoint mismatch.

assessments.quote: The purpose of this study was to explore the value of preoperative circulating tumor cells (CTCs) status and tumor size in guiding the resection margin width of patients with HCC.
assessments.reason: Study on CTC status and tumor size to guide resection margin, not MRI-based MVI prediction. Task and modality mismatch.

assessments.quote: Primary clear cell carcinoma of the liver (PCCCL) is an uncommon hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) subtype that resembles extrahepatic clear cell tumors, posing diagnostic challenges.
assessments.reason: Case report on a rare HCC subtype with surgery and TACE; no MRI MVI prediction. Irrelevant to the question.
